Jordan —

Thanks for the SOW and the quick turnaround. Short answer: our standard policy is PO-required for any billable engagement, but we do have a conditional invoice-only/onboarding path for limited pilots under $5k provided certain controls and evidence are in place.

To evaluate, we need the following from your side:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (standard)
- Signed SOW (we received draft; need signature)
- Vendor W-9 or equivalent tax form (if US entity)
- Point of contact for billing and a purchase email address

If you can provide those items we can route this to Finance/Procurement for an exception review. The exception typically includes: a 60-day invoice-only term, a single-invoice cap (no incremental PO), and evidence of insurance or a waiver if lower coverage.

Im looping in Priya from Procure to advise on the checklist and Marissa from Sales for the commercial OK.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Team —

Reviewed the docs Jordan sent. Proposal for an exception (recommended):
- Allow invoice-only onboarding for this pilot up to $5,000 total
- Term: 60 days from first invoice
- Single invoice only; prepayment not required but invoice must be net30
- Require signed SOW and completed onboarding form (received)
- Require a limited liability addendum acknowledging the lower insurance coverage (Ill draft)
- Finance to route invoice to billing@luminar.ai and mark as pilot exception on ledger

Risks: low-dollar exposure but we should tag the account for no-autorenew and require Sales to validate success metrics before any upsell. If the customer wants to convert to production or expand past $5k, standard PO/contract terms will apply.

Attaching procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx (internal) for audit trail.
